title: Boot Camp 1: Unit Control and Terrain

board.title: Boot Camp 1: Unit Control and Terrain

brief: Master the basics of unit control and terrain cover as a couple Scorpions tear up some abandoned Flak Tanks.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: Well, recruit, let's get down to business.
You've been granted control of two Scorpion Tanks.
Your task is to defeat the two enemy Flak Tanks.
The Flak Tank's weapon is weak against armored targets like the Scorpion Tank so you should have no problem dealing with these guys.
If you want to minimize the damage you take, we suggest you attack from these locations. The dense terrain will absorb some of the damage incurred during the enemy's counter attack.
Good luck, soldier!
Um.. I guess we need to try that again.
Great work, soldier. It is time to move on to your next lesson.

title: Boot Camp 2: Diverse Forces
brief: Learn about the distinction between ground, sea and air forces while you engage with some of the most powerful units on the battlefield.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: As an officer in the Northern Federation, you will often find yourself in control of ground, air and sea forces.
In this scenario you are being tasked with eliminating the enemy naval fleet and ground forces using a combination of your air force and ground troops.
The Condor Bomber is one of the most powerful units in the game. It can do massive damage to ground and sea targets.
Beware the enemy Rocket Truck. It is capable of firing on air, sea and ground targets and it has an impressive range, though it tends to be more effective against heavily armored targets.
The enemy Battlecruisers have a longer attack range than any other unit on the battlefield. Luckily, its guns cannot fire on your air units.
Remember to review the important tactical information that appears in the recon panel when you click on a unit or terrain. Good luck soldier!
You can win this battle without your ground forces.
Focus on eliminating the Rocket Truck and Flak Tank. If even one of your air units survives the encounter, the enemy will be unable to stop you.
Ready to give it another go?
Generally speaking, you will be commanding multi-disciplinary forces. Picking the right mix of air, sea and ground forces is the key to strategic victory. Let's move on to the next lesson.

title: Boot Camp 3: Chokepoints
brief: A choke point is all a capable commander needs to mount an effective defense, even against a larger enemy force.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: When the enemy outnumbers you, you must use chokepoints and the terrain to level the playing field.
I suggest you move two Scorpion Tanks into these positions to create a choke point.
This Rocket Truck's ranged attack can soften up the enemy units from safely behind your choke point.
Just remember that ranged units like the Rocket Truck cannot move and attack in the same turn. Begin!
Creating a defensible choke point at the start of this mission is key to surviving long enough to establish an army.
Remember to keep your Rocket Truck behind the choke point so that it can provide long range tactical support.
Sometimes you just need a little bit of recon. I understand. Let's give it another go.
Leveraging a strategic choke point can be the difference between success and defeat in many battles. Support your unranged units with long range artillery units like the Rocket Truck.

title: Boot Camp 4: Special Actions
brief: All units have special actions that can be triggered from the special actions menu. In this scenario, you'll learn about two special actions: Repairing and the Leviathan pickup.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: In some scenarios you'll be joining your troops mid-battle.
Here your forces have had to retreat across a channel after being pummeled by the enemy troops.
Rally your troops by repairing them from the safety of the remote island.
Repairing hurts the morale of your troops, so use it wisely on the frontlines.
The repair will complete at the start of your next turn and will repair up to 25% of the health of the unit. You can repair repeatedly until the unit is at 100% health.
If an enemy attacks you before the repair completes, you will lose the repair will fail and the unit will be unable to counterattack.
Once your army is back in top shape, call a fleet of Leviathans and take the island.
You can order repairs and Leviathan pickups from the special actions menu. Click twice on a unit to bring up its special actions menu.
Good luck, soldier.
Make sure you have repaired your units completely before mounting your assault.
Try to land all your Leviathans at the same time. It will reduce the effectiveness of the enemy's initial attack.
This is a harder mission, for sure, but we need to prepare you for the real thing. Let's try again.
Congratulations, soldier. It looks like you are almost ready to graduate from boot camp!

title: Boot Camp 5: Stealth Tanks
brief: Effective use of stealth technology can give the capable commander an edge in battle.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: Mastery of stealth and counter-stealth tactics is an essential battlefield tactic.
In this scenario you get to experience both sides of stealth encounters. Being the hunters and being the hunted.
You'll be hunting with these Scorpion Tanks. There are two enemy Stealth Tanks in their vicinity.
A Stealth Tank in waiting will cancel the move of any enemy unit that tries to travel through it and that unit will lose the rest of its turn.
So your best tactic when hunting Stealth Tanks is to expose it with your first unit, then strike it with your back up.
You'll be hunting the enemy Flaks with these two Stealth Tanks.
When hunting with Stealth Tanks, remember that you do double damage if you strike the target while you are still cloaked.
If you kill the target, you will not decloak. Ending your turn next to an enemy unit will always decloak your Stealth Tank.
Stealth Tanks have very little armor, so focus on picking off straggling targets to avoid losing your stealth cover.
Begin the training exercise!
The best way to tackle an invisible enemy is with clusters of troops. Scout ahead to expose the stealth units and then destroy them with the rest of your troops.
Give it another try. I'm sure it'll go better this time.
Stealth units like the Stealth Tank and U-Boat can be devastating in the hands of a capable general. On with the next lesson..

title: Boot Camp 6: War Machines
brief: Learn about War Machines and how to build armies.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: Keep your War Machines protected behind the Blockades while you build an army to take on the enemy.
Well done, soldier. On with your next lesson.
On some missions, you'll be placed in command of the mighty War Machine.
Use the War Machine's 'Build' action to create an army and defeat your enemies. Clicking the War Machine twice will open the action menu.
These Blockades will protect your War Machines for a few turns.
The enemy has to destroy them before he can reach your War Machines.

title: Boot Camp 7: Extraction
brief: In this scenario you will have to utilize the War Machine's extract ability to defeat your opponent.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: In some scenarios, you may not have enough resources in your War Machine to mount an effective assault on your enemy.
To defeat your enemy in these situations, you will have to extract resources from the various Ore Deposits that litter a level.
Move your War Machine to an Ore Deposit and activate the Extract ability from the special actions menu to extract resources from the Ore Deposit.
There are two kinds of Ore Deposit on this level.
These are Enriched Ore Deposits that can be extracted twice for double the total resources.
Regular Ore Deposits can only be extracted once.
The enemy is fielding a new unit on this level called a Jammer Truck.
The Jammer Truck is a support unit with no offensive capabilities but it is an essential component of most armies.
Clicking on a Jammer Truck will reveal its jamming zone. The jamming zone cannot be entered by aircraft and it will decloak stealth units.
Remember that the Blockades will buy you some time while you establish your army.
Engage!
You probably can't save the exposed War Machine, but you should still see if you can slow down the enemy's advance on your protected War Machine.
Remember to use your War Machine to extract resources from the Ore Deposits.
I bet that was stressful. Nice job! We've only got one last lesson to go through.

title: Boot Camp 8: Face Off
brief: This scenario accurately depicts challenges you might encounter on the front lines, requiring you to defeat an enemy as tactically capable as yourself.
objective: Do the stuff the brief told you to do... quick... smart...

do.message: It is time to put your tactical skills to the test. Good luck soldier, make us proud!
Your enemy is commanding a force of approximately the same tactical strength so you have to utilize terrain cover and choke points to defeat your opponent.
We'll get everything set up for when you're ready to tackle this scenario again.
Congratulations! You have completed your boot camp training. Head back to headquarters and prepare for departure to the front lines.
